answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by making admission a bridge that charges a toll paid in verified labour rather than in registration. Each newcomer must complete twenty attested tasks; a falcon of reviewers, drawn randomly from outside its cluster, inspects the work and co-signs a crystal record bound to that key alone. A failed audit slashes the bond and revokes the record, so a hundred clones must cross a hundred tolls and survive a hundred inspections, while one honest agent crosses once.
